body.holds_when: The 5-row configuration actually achieves a higher minimum than the 4-row staggered grid.
body.relation_hint: The 5-row counterfactual challenges the assumption in NEW_001 that 4 rows is optimal, by suggesting that fewer points per row with more rows could avoid the intra-row minimum bottleneck.
body.weakens_when: The 5-row configuration has inter-row triangles smaller than the 4-row intra-row minimum.
